audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts said Lillia wins Levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 (full.phases[].side and content win[]), while every why/whys line under them says Darius wins those stages outright. The packet levelChart (Darius x6, Lillia at 2+ items) and the 52.79% Emerald+ win rate agree with the prose, not the chart.
audit.why: Lillia has no dash and no hard CC before 6 (kit: Q 450 self-centred AoE, W 500 zone, E 700 projectile slow, R 150s). Darius with Apprehend at 535 range simply out-stats her every stage until she has two items.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped to Darius for Level 1 through First item, Lillia at Two+ items; ratings moved onto the Darius-favoured scale. Proposed as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] (Lvl 6) said Lilting Lullaby 'needs her Q trail to build damage' and told you to kill her 'if she's low on Hemorrhage stacks' — backwards, since Noxian Guillotine scales UP with stacks. spikes[2] (1st item) credited the move-speed kite to 'W Watch Out! passive move-speed'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Lilting Lullaby drowses 'all enemies with Dream Dust on them' (Dream Dust comes from Dream-Laden Bough, the passive), 150/130/110s cooldown. The stacking move speed is on Blooming Blows (Q) passive — 'Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells'. Watch Out! Eep! (W) is a 14/13/12/11/10s damage zone with no move speed at all.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now names Lilting Lullaby, its 150s rank-1 cooldown and the Dream Dust requirement, and tells you to stack Hemorrhage TO five before executing. spikes[2] moves the move speed onto Blooming Blows (Q) passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentioned that Blooming Blows' outer edge deals TRUE damage, and never mentioned Swirlseed (E) at all — her only slow and the single tool that stops your run-down.
audit.why: Kit: Blooming Blows 'deal[s] magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge' (trueDamage flag). Swirlseed is a 700-range projectile, flat 12s at every rank, with a slow — the exact counter to Crippling Strike + Ghost. Against a Darius who buys armour, the true-damage edge is the reason armour reads the chase wrong.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early now states the true-damage edge; dosFull[0], breakdown.cooldowns, winCon and loading now key the engage to Swirlseed's flat 12s window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Worse, dosFull[0] and loading told you to engage 'on Blooming Blows's cooldown' — that ability is 6s at rank 1 and 4s at rank 5, so it is never meaningfully down.
audit.why: The punishable cooldowns in this lane are Swirlseed (flat 12s) and Watch Out! Eep! (14s at rank 1). Your own Apprehend is 26s at rank 1, which is what a whiff actually costs you.
audit.corrected: Advice re-keyed to Swirlseed 12s and Apprehend 26s, with real numbers in breakdown.cooldowns, phases[1].why, breakdown.mid and content mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Lillia as 'he/his' throughout (tldr, winCon, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, phases[0].why, dosFull, ahead).
audit.why: Lillia is female; the content layer already uses 'she'. The two layers render on the same page.
audit.corrected: Gender fixed in every string this proposal rewrites.

audit.why: Emerald+ headline is 52.79% over 1,794 games — a genuine Darius-favoured lane, which is why the chart flip in point 2 is the right direction.

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kite + move speed stacks. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.

edits.before: Lillia's R Lullaby only puts enemies to sleep after a delay and needs her Q trail to build damage, so it does nothing to stop a point-blank R Noxian Guillotine — if she's low on Hemorrhage stacks, you simply reset and kill her before the drowsy lands.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby (R) is 150s at rank 1, needs Dream Dust already on you, and only turns Drowsy into sleep after a delay — too slow to pre-empt a point-blank Noxian Guillotine. Stack Hemorrhage to five, then execute and reset before the sleep lands.

edits.before: Trinity Force or Stridebreaker keeps you glued to her; Lillia wants to kite with W Watch Out! passive move-speed, but Stridebreaker's slow plus your E pull erases the gap and lets you full-rotate for another execute.
edits.after: Trinity Force or Stridebreaker keeps you glued to her; Lillia kites on Blooming Blows (Q) passive move speed, stacked by every spell she lands, but Stridebreaker's slow plus your E pull erases the gap for another full-rotation execute.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are your kill window: your all-in with E into full rotation out-trades her every time and she can't punish because Lullaby is a slow, telegraphed sleep. Snowball this wave dominance into a lead before she can farm to relevance.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are your kill window: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1, so pull only on a certain step-up — a whiff hands her 26 free seconds. Land it, W-slow, Q the outer blade, and snowball this wave dominance before she farms to relevance.

notes: Two derived-flag misfires in the kits, reported not acted on: (1) darius.json flags Apprehend (E) as 'knockup', but Riot's own text says it 'sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him' — it is a pull, not a knockup, so it does not enable knockup-dependent follow-ups. (2) lillia.json flags Swirlseed (E) as 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes'; Riot's text only says the seed 'will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target', so nothing is created. Both trusted per the description, per instruction. Also left alone deliberately: diffRating 8.5/10 and breakdown.difficulty 'Overall difficulty: 8.5/10 / Hard matchup' sit oddly next to diff FAV, a 52.79% win rate and a chart Darius now wins 6/7 — see questionsForUser. focus.text 'Lillia Blooming Blows' with letters ['Q'] left as-is because the Q passive move speed genuinely is her kite engine, even though Swirlseed is the punishable cooldown.
